purpose: Lints a prediction-market event contract's DECLARED settlement terms (source agency kind, unresolvable-outcome fallback, revision rule, expiration-value rule, discretion clause, outcome review availability, dispute window, settlement delay bound, early-close rule, carve-out flag, outcome exhaustiveness and exclusivity) against a caller-declared policy, and emits one PASS or FINDING line per declared policy item plus one intrinsic consistency check, with an overall verdict of PASS, PASS_WITH_FINDINGS or FAIL. Venue-neutral: the only profile knowledge is a closed data table (kalshi_rulebook_v1_29, generic) that marks which finding items carry a pinned primary-text basis; findings cite opaque rule_key identifiers that the node page maps to the pinned passages. Inputs are enums, booleans, integers and opaque labels only -- prose, URLs and identifier-like values are refused, never echoed.
